afh_2_0_reference._note: The frozen AfH 2.0 inputs (SNAPSHOT.md). A run on other inputs is computed in full and labelled afh_2_0_snapshot: false.
afh_2_0_reference.pacer_note: pacer_sha256 is the full release (219 files), in pacer-v2.zip on Zenodo (restricted); run_all.sh needs it
afh_2_0_reference.pacer_public_note: the 189 files git ships (the 30 cases/ bundles stay out); document-type counts ship as numbers/pacer_doc_types.json

NFeatures_breakdown.rule: a value read from the case text and stored for the case; a list counts each value; labels count, and the quoted spans behind them are listed, not counted; placeholders, program boilerplate, provenance and copies of other attributes are excluded

agency_grounds.reason: provenance: where each agency was found

location_grounds.reason: provenance: where each location was found

person_spans.reason: provenance: name spans used for masking

comparison_values.reason: derived comparison keys, not read from the text

ml_features.reason: model input vector, not an extracted value

date_range.reason: publication dates, counted from date assertions

press_digest_pollution.reason: quality flag on the source text

severity_phrases.reason: quoted spans behind severity_indicators (the labels are counted)

perpetrator_admissions.reason: quoted spans behind perpetrator_admission_themes (the labels are counted)

investigation_technology.reason: one flag value ('CyberTipline'); in 745 of 1,810 frozen-corpus cases its only mention is a report-to-the-CyberTipline line (program boilerplate), and the stored value cannot tell the two apart

locations.reason: place names; location_grounds records what a place is (state, city), never its role, so offense locations cannot be told from an agency's or court's; left out by the maintainer 2026-11-24

Ephemerality.verdict: first appears in the last qualifying cohort; recurrence untestable

uncovered_share.rule: Empty harm set among cases in none of ai_no_identifiable_child, attempted_contact, and sting_no_minor, over that same set.

rules.contact_and_approach: topic hands_on or sextortion, or h1 or h4 in the codebook-9 case harm set
rules.production: topic production, or h2 in the case harm set
rules.possession_and_trade: topic possession or distribution, or h3 in the case harm set
rules.coordination: extracted multi_defendant_operation, or a §2252A(g) child exploitation enterprise charge named in the case text; naming Discord or a game platform alone does not count
rules.overlap: a case can be in several families

reliability_overall.note: agreement on acts the models coded; the docket parser's acts are excluded

8_limitations.rule: topic csam, ai_csam, possession, distribution or production

stated_clean.what: stated tier without the 0 boilerplate-only edges (cooc-boilerplate-1)

all_clean.what: all tiers without the 106 boilerplate-only edges (cooc-boilerplate-1)

13_publication_year.rule: a stored publication year is corrected when >= 2 of the record's publication evidence fields (case-id year, compilation-file year, stated publication dates) agree on another year and none supports the stored one; an event date supports the stored year only when no publication date is stated
13_publication_year.sensitivity_values: year_sensitivity.json (every year-dependent value with and without the flagged records)

levels.A: registry default_on on the platform, window (since..ended) open at publication
levels.A_any: capability available on the platform at publication (registry window since..ended open), default_on or not; B, I and C nest within it
levels.I: inferred facilitation (B on a default_on platform with its window open, or C)

boilerplate_app_lists.rule: every sentence naming the platform is awareness/list framing (is_awareness_or_list_framing), or names 3+ of the case's platforms and is a bare enumeration (is_enumeration_only)
boilerplate_app_lists.status: upper bound: every flagged record is counted as boilerplate

facebook_double_tag.rule: a 'Facebook' tag whose only textual source is the phrase 'Facebook Messenger' becomes 'Facebook Messenger' (afhq1/labels.py)
facebook_double_tag.applied: at load, in every AfH output (snapshot cases, Q1 records, manifest, harm tables, co-occurrence); the DB is unchanged
facebook_double_tag.cause: the platform matcher tags 'Facebook' inside the phrase 'Facebook Messenger'

yahoo_chat.resolution: both capability years are right for their product (public chat rooms closed Dec 14, 2012; Yahoo! Messenger private messages until Jul 17, 2018). The platform-level end was wrong: the label also matches 'Yahoo! Messenger' (pattern_processing.py, the 'Yahoo Chat' platform pattern).
yahoo_chat.fix: capability_sources/messaging.yaml Yahoo Chat ended 2012 -> 2018; platforms.yaml regenerated (until 2012 -> 2018).
